basic_info_description: Complete this onboarding process to start using {{company.name}}. Let's start with basic details.
address_description: Please enter your permanent address, which we require to verify your identity.
identity_description: It must contain an official photo ID.
finances_description: Choose a document to upload as proof of income
onboarding_success: We've received all your information and will get back to you shortly. You will get an email notification once your account has been verified.
verify_later_banner: You can continue to the app and complete verification later
add_shareholder_title: No shareholders, click the 'Plus' button to add a shareholder
progress_continue_subtitle: Tap the banner to complete your onboarding
progress_pending_subtitle: Your onboarding documents are pending review
progress_failed_subtitle: Your information could not be verified

business_branding_subtitle: Configure the look and feel of your invoices and other documents with the brand settings below.

no_requirements_for_tier: No requirements for this tier. Continue to the next tier.
